t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are 2 gnomes which each pick up 3 different coloured baskets (baskets are red and yellow).

vb_textbox.text: Pick any gnome to start off with, then choose the similar coloured gnomes, e,g, red, brown, until the number of mushrooms gets low, then switch to the other set of coloured gnomes, e.g. blue/green.  Good luck!!!
